final: WITH manager_throws AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) as count_managers FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count_managers) as total_count FROM manager_throws), shares AS (SELECT mt.throws, mt.count_managers, mt.count_managers * 1.0 / (SELECT total_count FROM totals) as share FROM manager_throws mt), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_sh FROM shares), filtered AS (SELECT s.throws, s.count_managers, s.share FROM shares s, avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_sh) SELECT SUM(count_managers) as total_of_counts, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_sh FROM avg_share)) as avg_excess FROM filtered
